svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 72.9B tokens, 94.1% cache hit, $67,790.20 estimated cost, peak 5.8B on 06-06. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
